# Discourse on Thinking

*[Martin Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) · 1959 · *Gelassenheit**

A volume bringing together a speech given in 1955 at Messkirch, his home town, and a dialogue composed from notes of 1944-1945. [Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) there sets meditative thinking against calculative thinking, and proposes toward technical objects a simultaneous "yes and no", [releasement](../glossary/gelassenheit.md).
